title: Because She Is a Mother
synopsis: Two touching stories of wonderful Chinese mothers from different generations!

fullText.simplified:
因为她是妈妈

    一位自媒体人在街头采访了一名年轻的女性外卖员。在交流过程中，女孩用她的真诚、善良、坚强和甜美的笑容打动了自媒体人，也打动了每一个看视频的人。
    这位来自江西的姑娘只有21岁，带着一个三岁的孩子在安徽生活。因为一场车祸，她失去了丈夫。她的婆婆不仅拿走了死亡赔偿金，还把她和孩子赶出了家门。她自己的父母不愿意她抚养亡夫的孩子，希望她趁年轻重新嫁人。为了孩子，她离开了老家，一个人带着孩子在安徽靠送外卖生活。但是当自媒体人提出帮助她时，她却拒绝了，她说：“我现在过得很好。我有能力养活自己并且照顾好孩子。我对未来充满信心。”
    看了视频的网友都记住了这位姑娘自信的笑容，也记住了姑娘说的话。在网友们的评论中，“为母则刚”这句话是说的最多的。是啊，“为母则刚”。作为母亲，当她有了孩子，她就成了“超人”，她可以面对和解决无数的困难和麻烦。
    还有一个妈妈的故事来自朋友的讲述。我朋友的妈妈是一个传统的中国女性，经历了很多磨难：战争、饥荒、瘟疫等等。朋友说她觉得她妈妈特别厉害，总有化腐朽为神奇的力量。
    小时候，家里穷，人口多，饭不够吃，她的妈妈却总能把有限的食材变成美味的食物，尽量让每个人都吃饱、吃好。
    朋友小时候爱美，看见别人穿漂亮的衣服，她也想要。但是因为家里穷，买不起新衣服。她的妈妈却总能在几天以后，给她拿出一套漂亮的衣服。后来爸爸告诉她，那是妈妈去别人家看了好几天新衣服的样式，回家后自己一针一线缝出来的。长大后，每次想到当时的情况，朋友都会觉得不好意思，怪自己当时不能体谅妈妈的不易。
    后来，妈妈老了，脑子不好使了，有时甚至连朋友的名字都不记得了。偶尔朋友会觉得妈妈故意在捣乱，明明什么都做不了，却偏偏还想要管东管西，所以会批评妈妈或者跟妈妈发脾气。在妈妈生命的最后一刻，朋友听见妈妈用虚弱的声音说：“孩子，我想再陪你几年。我怕我走了，你会孤单。”当时，朋友对妈妈的话没有太深的感触，直到妈妈过世以后，朋友才真正明白，妈妈真的太明智了。因为妈妈早就知道没有妈妈的孩子是孤单的，所以她才想努力活下去。朋友说：“因为她是妈妈啊！我明白得太晚了。”
    “为母则刚”，妈妈可以用她的肩膀给孩子搭起一个乐园；妈妈就算忘了一切，也不会忘了孩子的所有；直到生命的尽头，她还在考虑如何让她的孩子过得更好。朋友们，好好地爱我们的妈妈。因为她是妈妈！是世界上最爱我们的人。
fullText.traditional:
因為她是媽媽

    一位自媒體人在街頭採訪了一名年輕的女性外賣員。在交流過程中，女孩用她的真誠、善良、堅強和甜美的笑容打動了自媒體人，也打動了每一個看視頻的人。
    這位來自江西的姑娘只有21歲，帶著一個三歲的孩子在安徽生活。因為一場車禍，她失去了丈夫。她的婆婆不僅拿走了死亡賠償金，還把她和孩子趕出了家門。她自己的父母不願意她撫養亡夫的孩子，希望她趁年輕重新嫁人。為了孩子，她離開了老家，一個人帶著孩子在安徽靠送外賣生活。但是當自媒體人提出幫助她時，她卻拒絕了，她說：“我現在過得很好。我有能力養活自己並且照顧好孩子。我對未來充滿信心。”
    看了視頻的網友都記住了這位姑娘自信的笑容，也記住了姑娘說的話。在網友們的評論中，“為母則剛”這句話是說的最多的。是啊，“為母則剛”。作為母親，當她有了孩子，她就成了“超人”，她可以面對和解決無數的困難和麻煩。
    還有一個媽媽的故事來自朋友的講述。我朋友的媽媽是一個傳統的中國女性，經歷了很多磨難：戰爭、饑荒、瘟疫等等。朋友說她覺得她媽媽特別厲害，總有化腐朽為神奇的力量。
    小時候，家裡窮，人口多，飯不夠吃，她的媽媽卻總能把有限的食材變成美味的食物，儘量讓每個人都吃飽、吃好。
    朋友小時候愛美，看見別人穿漂亮的衣服，她也想要。但是因為家裡窮，買不起新衣服。她的媽媽卻總能在幾天以後，給她拿出一套漂亮的衣服。後來爸爸告訴她，那是媽媽去別人家看了好幾天新衣服的樣式，回家後自己一針一線縫出來的。長大後，每次想到當時的情況，朋友都會覺得不好意思，怪自己當時不能體諒媽媽的不易。
    後來，媽媽老了，腦子不好使了，有時甚至連朋友的名字都不記得了。偶爾朋友會覺得媽媽故意在搗亂，明明什麼都做不了，卻偏偏還想要管東管西，所以會批評媽媽或者跟媽媽發脾氣。在媽媽生命的最後一刻，朋友聽見媽媽用虛弱的聲音說：“孩子，我想再陪你幾年。我怕我走了，你會孤單。”當時，朋友對媽媽的話沒有太深的感觸，直到媽媽過世以後，朋友才真正明白，媽媽真的太明智了。因為媽媽早就知道沒有媽媽的孩子是孤單的，所以她才想努力活下去。朋友說：“因為她是媽媽啊！我明白得太晚了。”
    “為母則剛”，媽媽可以用她的肩膀給孩子搭起一個樂園；媽媽就算忘了一切，也不會忘了孩子的所有；直到生命的盡頭，她還在考慮如何讓她的孩子過得更好。朋友們，好好地愛我們的媽媽。因為她是媽媽！是世界上最愛我們的人。

sentences.traditional: 明明什麼都做不了，卻偏偏還想要管東管西，
sentences.pinyin: míng míng shén me dōu zuò bù liǎo què piān piān hái xiǎng yào guǎn dōng guǎn xī
sentences.english: Occasionally, my friend would think that her mother was deliberately causing trouble.

sentences.simplified: 所以会批评妈妈或者跟妈妈发脾气。
sentences.traditional: 所以會批評媽媽或者跟媽媽發脾氣。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ huì pī píng mā ma huò zhě gēn mā ma fā pí qi
sentences.english: It was obvious that she couldn’t do anything, yet she still stubbornly wanted to meddle in everything.

sentences.simplified: 在妈妈生命的最后一刻，朋友听见妈妈用虚弱的声音说：
sentences.traditional: 在媽媽生命的最後一刻，朋友聽見媽媽用虛弱的聲音說：
sentences.pinyin: zài mā ma shēng mìng de zuì hòu yí kè péng you tīng jiàn mā ma yòng xū ruò de shēng yīn shuō
sentences.english: So, sometimes she criticized her mother or lost her temper with her.

sentences.simplified: “孩子，我想再陪你几年。我怕我走了，你会孤单。”
sentences.traditional: “孩子，我想再陪你幾年。我怕我走了，你會孤單。”
sentences.pinyin: hái zi wǒ xiǎng zài péi nǐ jǐ nián wǒ pà wǒ zǒu le nǐ huì gū dān
sentences.english: In the final moment of her mother’s life, my friend heard her mother say in a weak voice, ..

sentences.simplified: 当时，朋友对妈妈的话没有太深的感触，
sentences.traditional: 當時，朋友對媽媽的話沒有太深的感觸，
sentences.pinyin: dāng shí péng you duì mā ma de huà méi yǒu tài shēn de gǎn chù
sentences.english: .. “Child, I want to stay with you for a few more years. I’m afraid that if I leave, you will be lonely.”

sentences.simplified: 直到妈妈过世以后，朋友才真正明白，妈妈真的太明智了。
sentences.traditional: 直到媽媽過世以後，朋友才真正明白，媽媽真的太明智了。
sentences.pinyin: zhí dào mā ma guò shì yǐ hòu péng you cái zhēn zhèng míng bai mā ma zhēn de tài míng zhì le
sentences.english: At that time, my friend didn’t think too deeply about what her mother said.

sentences.simplified: 因为妈妈早就知道没有妈妈的孩子是孤单的，所以她才想努力活下去。
sentences.traditional: 因為媽媽早就知道沒有媽媽的孩子是孤單的，所以她才想努力活下去。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi mā ma zǎo jiù zhī dào méi yǒu mā ma de hái zi shì gū dān de suǒ yǐ tā cái xiǎng nǔ lì huó xià qù
sentences.english: It was only after she passed away that my friend really understood that her mother was very wise.

sentences.simplified: 朋友说：“因为她是妈妈啊！我明白得太晚了。”
sentences.traditional: 朋友說：“因為她是媽媽啊！我明白得太晚了。”
sentences.pinyin: péng you shuō yīn wèi tā shì mā ma a wǒ míng bai de tài wǎn le
sentences.english: Because her mother had long known that a child without a mother is lonely. That’s why she wanted to try to stay alive.
My friend said, “Because she was a mom! I understood it too late.”

sentences.simplified: “为母则刚”，妈妈可以用她的肩膀给孩子搭起一个乐园；
sentences.traditional: “為母則剛”，媽媽可以用她的肩膀給孩子搭起一個樂園；
sentences.pinyin: wèi mǔ zé gāng mā ma kě yǐ yòng tā de jiān bǎng gěi hái zi dā qǐ yí ge lè yuán

sentences.simplified: 妈妈就算忘了一切，也不会忘了孩子的所有；
sentences.traditional: 媽媽就算忘了一切，也不會忘了孩子的所有；
sentences.pinyin: mā ma jiù suàn wàng le yí qiè yě bú huì wàng le hái zi de suǒ yǒu
sentences.english: “A mother is strong.” A mother can use her shoulders to build a paradise for her child.

sentences.simplified: 直到生命的尽头，她还在考虑如何让她的孩子过得更好。
sentences.traditional: 直到生命的盡頭，她還在考慮如何讓她的孩子過得更好。
sentences.pinyin: zhí dào shēng mìng de jìn tóu tā hái zài kǎo lǜ rú hé ràng tā de hái zi guò de gèng hǎo
sentences.english: Even if a mother forgets everything else, she will not forget anything about her child.

sentences.simplified: 朋友们，好好地爱我们的妈妈。因为她是妈妈！是世界上最爱我们的人。
sentences.traditional: 朋友們，好好地愛我們的媽媽。因為她是媽媽！是世界上最愛我們的人。
sentences.pinyin: péng you men hǎo hǎo de ài wǒ men de mā ma yīn wèi tā shì mā ma shì shì jiè shang zuì ài wǒ men de rén
sentences.english: Until the end of her life, she will still think about how to make her child’s life better.

sentence_translations: Because She Is a Mother
A self-media content creator interviewed a young female food delivery worker on the street.
In the process of interaction, the creator was touched by the girl’s sincerity, kindness, strength, and sweet smile, ..
.. and everyone who watched the video was also touched.
This young woman from Jiangxi was only 21 years old and lived in Anhui with her 3-year-old child.
She lost her husband in a car accident.
Her mother-in-law not only took the death compensation but also kicked her and her child out of the house.
Her own parents did not want her to raise her deceased husband’s child and hoped that she would remarry while she was still young.
For the sake of her child, she left her hometown.
She raised her child by herself in Anhui, depending on a food delivery job to make a living.
But when the creator offered to help her, she declined, saying, ..
.. “I am doing fine now. I am capable of supporting myself and taking care of my child.
I am full of confidence in the future.”
The internet users who watched the video all remembered the young woman’s confident smile and also remembered what the young woman said.
“A mother is strong” was the most frequently used phrase in the comments of internet users.
Yes, “a mother is strong”. As a mother, when she has a child, she becomes a “superwoman”.
She can face and solve countless difficulties and troubles.
A friend of mine told me another story about a mother. My friend’s mother was a traditional Chinese woman.
She had gone through many trials and tribulations: war, famine, plagues, and so on.
My friend said she thinks her mother is especially formidable and has the power to turn bad into good.
When she was a child, her family was poor, and there were many mouths to feed, so there was not enough food to eat.
Her mother always managed to turn the limited ingredients into delicious meals, trying her best to make sure everyone was full and ate well.
When my friend was a child, she wanted to look beautiful. When she saw others wearing beautiful clothes, she wanted to have them too.
But because her family was poor, they couldn’t afford to buy new clothes.
Yet, her mother would always be able to produce a beautiful outfit for her a few days later.
Her father later told her that her mother had gone to someone else’s house for several days to see the style of new clothes.
Then she came home and sewed them herself, stitch by stitch.
After growing up, every time she thought of that situation, my friend would feel embarrassed, ..
.. and blame herself for not being able to show some understanding for her mother’s difficulties at that time.
Later, her mother got old, and her mind wasn’t as sharp as it used to be. Sometimes, she couldn’t even remember my friend’s name.
Occasionally, my friend would think that her mother was deliberately causing trouble.
It was obvious that she couldn’t do anything, yet she still stubbornly wanted to meddle in everything.
So, sometimes she criticized her mother or lost her temper with her.
In the final moment of her mother’s life, my friend heard her mother say in a weak voice, ..
.. “Child, I want to stay with you for a few more years. I’m afraid that if I leave, you will be lonely.”
At that time, my friend didn’t think too deeply about what her mother said.
It was only after she passed away that my friend really understood that her mother was very wise.
Because her mother had long known that a child without a mother is lonely. That’s why she wanted to try to stay alive.
My friend said, “Because she was a mom! I understood it too late.”
“A mother is strong.” A mother can use her shoulders to build a paradise for her child.
Even if a mother forgets everything else, she will not forget anything about her child.
Until the end of her life, she will still think about how to make her child’s life better.
Friends, let’s love our mothers well. Because she is a mother! They love us the most in this world.
